Name: Mana Casks
Description: Every battle starts with extra mana orbs.
Barks: Casks sloshing fine today. Mind you don't sit on the blue one.
Orbs keep better in oak. Don't ask me why. Nobody's ever told me why.
The Longmother's gait sets the casks humming. Good sign, that.

Name: Medic Wagon
Description: The inn opens on the road, mid-expedition, at a premium.
Barks: Bandages boiled, cots aired. Try to come back in one piece anyway.
If it stings, it's working. If it doesn't sting, come see me.
I charge for the road, not the stitching. The road is the hard part.

Levels.Text: Inn on the road at ×2 price
Inn on the road at ×1.5 price

Name: Armory Wagon
Description: A travelling forge: repairs cost less.
Barks: Bring me the dented ones. The shiny ones never have stories.
Shed plate makes a fine anvil. She grows a new one every season.
Every crack's a lesson. Some lessons are just more expensive.

Name: Strongbox
Description: A bigger cut of the spoils when an expedition is completed.
Barks: Count twice, spend once. That's not a saying, that's a rule.
The box is locked. The key is somewhere you'll never think to look.
Finish the whole road and I'll show you what a bonus looks like.

Name: Scouts
Description: Outriders report what each battle holds.
Barks: Tracks up ahead. Big ones. Wren says small ones. Wren is wrong.
We ride out at first light and come back before the soup's gone.
Ground's souring off the east flank. Keep her walking.

Name: Enchanter's Wagon
Description: A rune-loft for the Enchantress's work: armor enchants cost less gold.
Barks: I ground the dust fine as flour. She says it's still too coarse.
Runes take better on the move. Something about the rhythm of her steps.
Bring armor with a story in it. The workings hold tighter.

Name: Quartermaster's Ledger
Description: Every scrap is written down and nothing is wasted: salvage returns more materials.
Barks: Three iron ore, one wolf pelt, half a cog. It's all in the book.
You'd be amazed what a broken blade is worth with the right column.
If it isn't in the ledger, it didn't happen. If it is, it's mine to sort.
